# wallix-bastion_config_wsm (Data Source)

Get information on the global Web Session Manager (WSM) configuration. Requires API v3.12+.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the current global WSM configuration
data "wallix-bastion_config_wsm" "current" {}

output "wsm_hostname" {
  value = data.wallix-bastion_config_wsm.current.hostname
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `jwe_public` (String, Sensitive)
- `jws_private` (String, Sensitive)
- `jws_public` (String)

## Usage Notes

### No Lookup Key

`config_wsm` is a singleton: there is only one WSM configuration on the Bastion, so this data
source takes **no arguments**. It always reads that single, global configuration — the same
configuration managed by the `wallix-bastion_config_wsm` resource, internally identified by the
fixed ID `wsmConfig`.

### Read-Only Key Material

`jws_private` always reads back masked (`********`) — it is a system-generated private key that
the API never actually exposes, included here only for parity with the raw API response.
